levels.name: Recall
levels.description: Direct recall of a stated fact or definition.

levels.name: Understand
levels.description: Explain a concept in the learner's own terms.

levels.name: Apply
levels.description: Use a concept to solve a straightforward problem.

levels.name: Analyse
levels.description: Compare approaches or reason about trade-offs.

levels.name: Evaluate
levels.description: Judge correctness, efficiency or edge cases.
